_README: The ONE place to set business details. Run `python3 tools/build.py` after editing; it rewrites public_html/. Values still in [BRACKETS] are not set yet — the build lists them.
_DOMAIN_help: Your domain without https://, e.g. roofrs.com
_FOUNDER_VIDEO_help: YouTube/Vimeo embed URL or /assets/video/intro.mp4 for the 60-second founder intro. Empty = placeholder card.
_US_PHONE_help: Display format of the WhatsApp number (shown as text in the footer and contact page; no call buttons).
_WHATSAPP_help: WhatsApp number in international format, digits only, e.g. 16085551234 (US) or 919876543210 (India). Used for every WhatsApp button (wa.me link).
_PRICE_SEO_help: [CONFIRM] SEO prices — used on every page, the chat and llms.txt.
LAUNCH_LINE: Launch price — goes to {after} after our first 10 roofing clients.
_LAUNCH_help: Set LAUNCH_PRICING to "off" to hide every launch-price line at once.
_DISPLAY_FONT_help: "jakarta" (Plus Jakarta Sans, minimalist — current), "anton" (Anton + Barlow Condensed, bold) or "archivo".
_SAME_AS_help: Comma-separated URLs of the BUSINESS's own profiles (Google Business Profile, Facebook, Clutch...). Goes into Organization schema sameAs.
_CHAT_AI_help: "on" sends questions the built-in answers cannot handle to Claude via chat.php. Needs an Anthropic API key in ../private/anthropic-key.txt (outside public_html) or the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY server env var.
